retainedVerifierFailures.reason: Verifier incorrectly required images with original empty currentSrc to load; corrected by resolving original incremental snapshot and comparing its recorded source.
Verifier action index included collapsed hook actions; original archive unchanged.
Verifier matched an earlier helper fill with the same value; exact original action snapshot identity correctly rejected it.
Verifier sent ArrowRight without selecting the tree item; bounded expansion rejected it.

archiveSizeObservation: Candidate ZIP entries are stored; reference entries are deflated. Candidate also contains more uncompressed data. No compression or body-collection change is adopted, and these bytes do not establish runtime attribution.
scopeLimits: Functional development aliases, not fresh packed consumers or a full application install/build.
All traces enabled on passing attempts; final on-first-retry backend policy, failures/retries and video remain separate.
Offline viewer checks cover 28 selected post-fill DOM/form/CSS/image/source states, not all actions or visual equivalence.
Input manifests bind selected files before and after; no loaded-memory or complete native library attestation.
Docker daemon services are outside the process-tree collector. No complete CPU/memory or final resource admission.
One execution per engine/worker cell, fixed order and no uncertainty estimate. Retained runner durations are raw functional observations, not a comparative performance benchmark.
No claim of 2x complete-suite performance, release acceptance, native CI or other-platform coverage.
Private raw archives and service records retain local application credentials and paths; public export contains only whitelisted counts, hashes and sanitized outcomes.
